// CLIConf stores command line arguments and flags:
type CLIConf struct {
	// UserHost contains "[login]@hostname" argument to SSH command
	UserHost string
	// Commands to execute on a remote host
	RemoteCommand []string
	// DesiredRoles indicates one or more roles which should be requested.
	DesiredRoles string

	Username string
	// Proxy keeps the hostname:port of the SSH proxy to use
	Proxy string

	MinsToLive int32
	// SSH Port on a remote SSH host
	NodePort int32
	// Login on a remote SSH host
	NodeLogin string

item.text: The new helper is wired into `Run`, and the tests cover an unset value, an environment default, and CLI precedence. The existing site and home helpers already implement the requested behavior; I added a test for the home override and am running the focused tests now.

`tsh` now uses `TELEPORT_KUBE_CLUSTER` as the default Kubernetes cluster when no cluster is specified on the CLI. The CLI value takes precedence. Existing handling already gives `TELEPORT_CLUSTER` precedence over `TELEPORT_SITE` and lets `TELEPORT_HOME` override the CLI home path while removing trailing slashes.

Added focused tests for the Kubernetes cluster precedence and home override. The relevant `tool/tsh` tests and `git diff --check` pass.
